title: Phandalin · Stonehill common room

sourceRecords.title: 4 · Stonehill Inn and rumors
read: The inn is warmer and louder than the street. Supper, wet cloaks, and low conversation crowd the common room. Several people glance toward your travel-worn gear. A child at one table stops talking mid-sentence.

Tables and travel-worn clothing break up the room, leaving conversations close enough to approach without addressing everyone at once. The child's sudden quiet is one detail among several. You can choose a seat, seek the keeper, or listen before deciding whose story you want to hear.

sourceRecords.title: Around the table · people, promises and custody
read: A cleared table fills with the things a journey leaves behind: a folded message, a borrowed tool, a list of names. Outside, ordinary work continues. Here, you have time to decide what must happen before another road is taken.

Each object on the table points toward someone who may still be waiting. The tool can be returned, the message answered, and the list checked against your own account. None of those tasks has to be buried beneath a new destination.
